scope: ALL40 full raw records including tails; no train/validation/test filtering
chronology: post-hoc full-data exploration after historical training/testing; may be presented in preprocessing section but not claimed as chronologically pretraining
raw_analysis: all samples enter raw descriptive statistics and full-record FFT; Welch/STFT add final unpadded segment aligned with record end
no_changes: no model training/inference, no band changes, no frozen output modification
energy: full-record mean-removed FFT squared, real-spectrum weights, nominal regions; no window normalization; within-record relative energy

welch.tail: append last full segment aligned to record end; no padding

sk.tail: append final full segment, no padding

local_analysis: all complete 0.5s segments from every record independent of roles; 687 expected; tails participate in full-record FFT, raw statistics, Welch and SK but are not padded into model-length segments
local_normalization: per-segment own mean/population std; NOT training-fitted feature normalization
feature_algorithm: unchanged existing Evidence: carrier |Butterworth response|^2 analytic mask; envelope48k→3k;75samples each end removed;6harmonics and fixed offset references
aggregation: segment mean within record; equal records within load/class; equal loads and fault classes; no window-based inferential test
controls: ALL6 references on ALL4 classes, including normal, for same-reference descriptive comparison; metadata label used for stratification not blind detection
limitations: all loads and historically tested data included; not independent generalization evidence
energy is not fault-information quantity; signal metrics do not establish classification contribution
multiple references and bands are dependent; record labels share bearing/rig and are not independent equipment replications
